text:
I highly recommend Dr. Mingming!

I originally came for teeth whitening, but a week before coming to Thailand, my gums started to become inflamed, swollen, and bleeding. I wasn't sure what was causing it, but Dr. Mingming immediately identified the cause and treated it, then did an Airflow treatment, which made it easy for someone like me who's terrified of dentists. Dr. Mingming's skills are amazing; he finished quickly and efficiently. With mouthwash, I think I'll recover quickly. The bleeding stopped the next day! 👍👍👍👍👍

Dr. Mingming also suggested that I see a filling specialist when I get back to Taiwan 🤣 (I just realized that you really do need to see a specialist to get the right treatment). He said it's better to get the fillings done first before getting whitening. I look forward to coming back and recommending it to my friends!

I had composite bonding done by Dr. Ming after booking in advance and paying a £100 deposit. The staff were all so lovely and welcoming, and the clinic itself is spotless and modern.
At first, I wasn’t completely sure about my teeth — they felt a bit strange (which I think everyone probably says at first!). Dr. Ming was amazing and reassured me that I could come back for any adjustments if I wanted, but after a few weeks I realised I just needed to get used to them.
It’s now been 3 weeks and I absolutely love them! I’ll only be going back to Dr. Ming for my checkups and any future dental work. Thank you so much — see you again soon!
